links.rationale: Manufacturer documents supervised ceiling-hole drilling for building-services fixings.
limitations: Validate hole schedule, substrate and current reach envelope.
Anchor insertion, fastening and acceptance are not performed by this drilling configuration.

links.rationale: FP2 prints coordinated wall, opening and fixing-point layout onto a prepared slab.
limitations: Survey control and approved files remain prerequisites.
German procurement and service remain unestablished.

links.rationale: SitePrint's documented floor-layout workflow matches transferring wall lines and fixing points from a prepared drawing.
limitations: Select and validate the exact station/prism/software package.
Layout marks do not construct or inspect the downstream elements.

links.rationale: TyBOT detects and ties horizontal mat intersections on supported deck work zones.
limitations: Bars must already be placed; unsupported ties remain manual.
Truss width, supports, bar geometry, tie schedule and German acceptance require review.

links.rationale: LIFTBOT can carry scaffold components vertically while the scaffolders erect the structure.
limitations: This is material transport only: no frame placement, guardrail installation or anchoring.
Human loading/unloading and an engineered rail/platform arrangement remain required.

links.rationale: Manufacturer reports LIFTBOT moving scaffold material during dismantling at BASF Ludwigshafen.
limitations: People dismantle, remove anchors and stack parts; the robot provides vertical transport.
The published industrial scaffold case does not establish every facade-scaffold configuration.

links.rationale: Current Hadrian offer automates digital-plan block placement using the manufacturer's wall-system configuration.
limitations: Compatible blocks and Fastbrick adhesive change the conventional masonry process.
German structural approval, complete wall detail, site access and exact-version deployment remain unresolved.
